label: Scene Template: Editorial Statement
description: WHOLE-SCENE template: the EDITORIAL statement beat. Huge display-SERIF type owns the frame -- one thought (or a rolling sequence of thoughts) on a warm cream canvas, with ONE word emphasized in gradient italic. This is the editorial-grammar workhorse: statement beats alternate with evidence beats to tell a story in type ('The registry is the *product*.'). Use for narration lines, chapter theses, and the open/close of editorial films. Distinct from st-manifesto (kinetic sans slam): st-statement is calm, serif, and literary. Themes: cream (default -- the editorial signature), light (the film's own light canvas), dark (the chapter-flip temperature).

text.label: The statement. Wrap the ONE key word/phrase in *stars* for the gradient-italic emphasis. Use \n to force line breaks.

lines.label: Rolling sequence: 2-3 statements that each hold, then roll up and out as the next rolls in (use INSTEAD of text for multi-thought beats)

kicker.label: Small caps label above (e.g. CHAPTER TWO)

theme.label: cream (default; 'light' aliases to cream) | dark (the chapter-flip temperature)

chapter_number.label: Chapter-card mode: a numeral ('02') rendered big in brand color beside the headline, which sets in SANS
